name: B10-0328/2026 (PPE) – Deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the deteriorating situation of political prisoners in Belarus, in particular the case of Aliaksandra Pulinovich
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It calls for the immediate release of Aliaksandra Pulinovich, jailed at 16 for 10 years and 3 months on charges the Parliament says are political, and of all political prisoners in Belarus. It condemns the Lukashenka regime's use of "extremism" and "terrorism" laws against peaceful people, and asks the Council to widen and enforce sanctions.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only asks Belarus to free Pulinovich and all political prisoners.
- It asks the Council to widen and strictly enforce sanctions on judges, prosecutors, prison officials and propagandists.
- It calls on Member States to apply universal jurisdiction so Lukashenka and his regime can be held accountable.
